# Crenel 1.2
- **Your mic is on when a recording starts.** Turn it off in the notch or with the shortcut. Muting yourself in Zoom or Google Meet still turns it off, and unmuting turns it back on. If Crenel can't read the call app's mute button, it leaves your mic as it is. - **Record Slack huddles and other calls.** Recording no longer stops with "couldn't verify the meeting audio" because the calendar has a Zoom or Meet link, Zoom is open in the background, or Chrome is playing something else. Calls in apps Crenel doesn't track directly (Slack, Teams, FaceTime) are recorded from all system audio. - **Cancel and Stop work in the notch.** Deleting a recording, cancelling setup and stopping processing are confirmed right in the notch, not in a system alert that could open out of reach. - **Calendar works right after you allow it.** No relaunch needed; Reminders too. - **The 🌐 key comes back as soon as you quit.** With fn as the dictation key, quitting Crenel or choosing another key restores your "Press 🌐 key to" setting immediately. Before, it took a restart.

# Crenel 1.1
- **Deepgram for meeting transcripts.** Choose Deepgram in Settings › AI › Voice as an alternative to ElevenLabs. Transcripts use Nova-3 with speaker labels, in Turkish, English or a detected language. Your Deepgram key is checked without uploading audio and kept in Keychain, separate from your ElevenLabs key. Choosing Deepgram sends the combined meeting recording to Deepgram. - **Markdown export.** Exported notes no longer name a transcription service, since the transcript doesn't record which one wrote it.

# Crenel 1.0
The first release. Crenel lives in the notch: your calendar, dictation, tasks and meeting notes in one place. Recordings and meeting notes are stored on your Mac.
- **Calendar in the notch.** The next event and how long until it starts, or how long is left in the one you're in. Join a call with one key; invites waiting for a reply are marked. - **Dictation.** Hold fn (🌐) and talk; the words go where your cursor is. Speech is turned into text on your Mac and never saved as audio. Long dictation grows into a live view, and you can take it back with Undo. - **Tasks.** Type one line: "tomorrow 3pm", "next Monday", "every Monday" are understood as you write. Tasks live in a "Crenel" list in Apple Reminders, so they're on your iPhone too. - **Meeting notes.** Crenel offers to record Zoom and Google Meet calls, then writes a transcript with speakers, a summary, decisions and action items. Export as Markdown, PDF or plain text. - **Your keys, your choice.** Apple Speech transcribes meeting audio on your Mac by default. Choosing ElevenLabs sends it the combined recording. Apple’s model handles notes locally. Choosing OpenAI or Anthropic sends transcript text to that provider. Claude Code sends text to Anthropic using your existing sign-in. OpenAI and Anthropic API providers can also clean up dictated text. - **Updates.** Crenel checks for updates itself and installs them when you're not on a call.
